cohort: Participants were pregnant individuals undergoing elective Cesarean section at 38-40 weeks gestational age at a university hospital in Zahedan.
finding: Maternal hemoglobin and hematocrit levels decreased significantly less in patients receiving spinal anesthesia compared to general anesthesia after Cesarean section.
mod_finding: Maternal hemoglobin and hematocrit levels decreased significantly less in patients receiving spinal anesthesia compared to general anesthesia during Cesarean section.
